testcase.name: an amount changed and changed back is the same food again
editing the amount of a reopened food leaves it decided with no question, no dimension and no learning
new foods, a removed food and the order of the edit are respected
a food whose amount changed is saved as the logger calculated it
a food picked by search keeps its verified source even though it has no analysis source
odd saved foods reopen without throwing and one without a usable amount stays unsaved until it is fixed
editing a verified food does not turn it into an estimate
an unchanged edit gives back the saved meal
every edited dimension of a reopened food is ignored as a confirmation
a manual macro edit of a reopened food stays decided and is a manual value
reopened foods get distinct card ids even when their saved ids are blank
a reopened verified food keeps its amount and nutrients, asks nothing and is not an estimate
a tag that came from the text or from the search is refreshed as before
blank or repeated saved ids never pair a food with the wrong one
the saved reference note comes back once, with and without the unmatched suffix
a food changed by hand or by another card is saved as calculated
reopening a food never confirms a dimension and never teaches a habit
a food the user did not touch is saved exactly as it was, with its evidence and unit
editing the amount of a reopened estimate keeps a range instead of an exact value
the edited meal keeps its id, notes and status and the day it was saved on
a reopened food raises no question where the same food, undecided, would ask
the date keeps its saved format while the day stays and uses the logger format when the day changes
the saved evidence decides the source kind and unknown provenance is an estimate
an untouched estimate keeps its saved range and note when the meal is saved again
a reopened estimate keeps its range and its estimate indicator
a food without a reference note gets no estimate evidence and no invented note
